title: Honor what the Guru honors
summary: The Guru speaks with sharp truth: from woman, woman is born, and from woman even kings are born. Where the Guru has placed honor, let speech and conduct carry dignity, not contempt.
takeaway: Let truth and dignity replace contempt in speech and conduct.
lifeApplication: Before contempt reaches the mouth, remember whom the Guru has already honored and choose the cleaner word, tone, and action.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru rebukes contempt and honors woman as the doorway through which human life comes.
source.lifeApplication: Before contempt reaches the mouth, let reverence and truth revise the next word, tone, and action.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru rebukes contempt and honors woman as the doorway through which human life comes.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: refuse to despise the one through whom human life comes.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before contempt reaches the mouth, remember whom the Guru has already honored and choose the cleaner word, tone, and action.
